Microstructural examinations from previous studies have shown that the favored sites for the formation of phases are boundaries and the reinforcementmatrix interface [27]. The phase of iron nitride formed in the XRD result (Fig: 2) is obviously due to the diffusion of iron and nitride at the boundary as indicated in the EDS result (Fig: 3b1). It is worthy to state that during the SPS process, non-equilibrium conditions exists in the material, which has a significant influence on diffusion and the reactions taking place during sintering: The formation ofFeNoo68 phasein thestudied compositesis as a result of intense phenomena place during SPS (surface activation, diffusion; surface melting, necking between the particles of sintered powder; and plastic flow [28]).
